narrative: On February 11, 2020, an employee was using a hose to spray off equipment. The employee attempted to move a conveyor belt, but its casters were locked; the employee's left hand slipped into the running conveyor belt, which amputated the middle fingertip.
An employee was operating a clamp lift truck to transport freight when it overturned, resulting in a severe leg injury.
An employee was opening the garage door to the warehouse to pick up materials. The employee tripped over the rope to the garage door and fell. He was hospitalized with a concussion.
An employee got his hand caught in the blade of a grinder cutting the fingertip and nail of the 3rd digit of the right hand. The fingertip was surgically amputated.
An employee was conducting an occupational therapy activity with a patient when the patient's dog bit the employee, lacerating her lip and cheek.

Employees were working on a press machine that had a mold that was leaking rubber. The employees proceeded towards the control panel to manually lower the mold. The injured employee entered the machine between the front knock-out slides, with a flashlight and approached the mold. Upon starting the inspection of the donut, the employee heard a suction sound. The employee was startled as the top plate came down and he quickly turned his head down and away from the front side of the machine. The employee struck his forehead on the left side rails and then fell backwards and struck the backside of his head on the opposite rail. The employee received staples to the back of the head and stitches to an eye and was hospitalized for a concussion.

An employee was taking pictures at the finish line of a track event. One of the participants finished the race and turned toward the employee. The runner struck the employee, knocking her to the ground and fracturing her right ankle.

On October 1, 2016, at approximately 2:30 p.m., an employee was going up the front porch steps of a private residence to make a sales call when he fell on the concrete porch and landed on his right elbow, fracturing his right ulna. He required surgery and was hospitalized.

An employee hopped approximately 4 feet from a loading dock down to the lower level. He stumbled and fell, lacerating his right wrist with a sharp metal object (no-hub coupling) he was holding. He was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was near a loader truck that was picking up and transporting pieces of old road concrete when a piece of concrete fell off the loader basket and struck the employee in the head, causing a concussion.
An employee was leading a horse into a show ring when the horse spooked, pulled itself to the end of the lead, and kicked the employee in the stomach. The employee suffered an intestinal injury.
On June 21, 2017,an employee was connecting two trailers with a converter dolly. The employee attempted to lift the dolly and suffered a back injury.

A temporary employee was responding to a report of moisture on a roll at the strip anneal line. The injured employee was using an absorbent pad to wipe the moisture on the rollers when the pad and employee's hand were pulled into the pinch roll. The employee sustained hand fractures and lacerations that required stitches.
An employee operating a forklift struck a pallet and was caught between the forklift and the pallets, avulsing his buttocks.
An employee fell out of the dump vehicle he was driving and was struck by it resulting in a crushed lower right leg.

An employee was unhitching a trailer and was putting it on a block when the trailer rolled off. The jack stand came off the block and landed on the employee's right foot, amputating his right big toe.

On 1/23/16 at 12:30, an employee was transferring a resident from one table to another in the dining hall via a wheelchair. The employee got caught on the resident's oxygen tubing and fell to the ground, fracturing her left elbow and requiring surgery.
An employee was using a walkie stacker when his thumb was caught between the handle and a rack, resulting in a laceration to his left thumb.
An employee was driving a utility task vehicle onsite when the vehicle flipped over and pinned the employee's leg, resulting in a tibia fracture.
An employee was involved in a physical altercation with an aggravated customer. The employee suffered a concussion.

An employee was on the lift gate of a box truck unloading when a cart containing food started rolling towards him. The employee jumped from the truck to the parking lot and fractured the right knee and left calcaneus.
A temporary employee was operating a bar drill. His hand was pinched between a table and a metal bar on the exit side of the drill. He suffered a crushed finger.

An employee was walking when a forklift carrying a 31-foot long, 7,000-pound steel support column ran them over and crushed their leg. The employee suffered blunt force trauma and amputation of his right leg from the knee down.

An employee was retrieving paint from a trash box that had been raised with a forklift to a second story balcony. The employee fell from the second story, landing about 18 feet below and suffering a dislocated right shoulder and a broken right elbow.

An employee was removing gutters. The employee stepped off a ladder onto the roof to remove a screw from the gutter, disturbed a wasp nest, and was stung repeatedly causing the employee to fall 15 feet from the roof edge. The employee was hospitalized for a laceration on the forehead.
An employee was injured while trying to clear a jam on an injection molding machine.

An employee was using an electric pallet jack to unload a truck. The pallet jack ran over a piece of wood, causing the steering column to swing and strike the employee's right leg. The employee's tibia was fractured.

On September 1, 2015, an employee parked his semi truck in the shop on the cement floor for servicing. He was going to lift the truck onto jack stands by first lifting it with the jack lift. While lifting the truck, the employee got down to the floor level to look beneath it. The handle of the jack lift fell, striking his left-hand little finger against the floor and resulting in a fingertip amputation.

An employee was collecting welding leads to leave work for the day. A 1-foot round pipe was on the ground and slid in mud caused by heavy rain. The pipe struck the employee in the leg, breaking his ankle.
Employee was cutting a base plate with a band saw. As the employee was cleaning off the metal shavings, the band saw caught his glove and amputated the left index finger above the knuckle.
An employee was riding a horse, corralling livestock, when the horse lost its footing and fell on the employee. The employee sustained a broken leg.

An employee was inserting webbing material into a blocking machine. The machine suddenly increased speed, and the employee's left hand was pulled between its rollers. The employee's pinky fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped on an antifatigue mat, falling to the floor and breaking a femur. The employee was hospitalized.

While holding a sheet metal part and bending it in a press brake, an employee's right ring fingertip was caught between the sheet metal part and the work rest. The right middle fingertip was amputated.
An employee was using a brush to clean a packaging machine. The machine was activated and the employee's finger got caught in the machine resulting in a fingertip amputation.
On November 4, 2022, an employee was removing pizza dough from under the production line when their hand was pulled into a conveyor roller. The employee sustained a left forearm fracture.

An employee was using a portable table saw to cut wood for a crate when the saw blade made contact with the employee's left hand, amputating part of his left ring finger at the middle joint and partially amputating the middle finger on the same hand.
An employee tripped over a trash can and fell to the floor, breaking her right ankle.

An employee was delivering a load of caustic liquid to a facility when he stepped in a puddle of unknown chemical composition, resulting in chemical burns to his right foot that required hospitalization.
An employee was adjusting the tension on the conveyor belt and caught their index finger between the belt and the roller resulting in a laceration.
An employee was trying to open the door to a semi trailer. The strap broke and the employee fell backward off the trailer to the ground, suffering a broken left elbow.

An employee was installing grading on a mezzanine level. Upon unhooking fall protection to move down to install grading, an iron beam support collapsed. The employee fell approximately 20 feet to the ground and sustained fractures of the ribs, tailbone, teeth, and a facial injury.

An employee was coming out of a bus and saw something laying on the ground. He was stepping to the side to miss the object when he fell and twisted his ankle, fracturing it and requiring hospitalization.

An employee was climbing an uprooted tree to clear branches away from electrical conductors. He was tied off to an adjacent tree with fall protection and a climb line. When the employee cut a tree limb, it released the tension in the limb, which struck him in the head and knocked him unconscious. The employee was hospitalized due to spinal edema.

An employee was assisting with moving a large medical cart. The cart's legs caught on a door jam during the move and the equipment fell onto the employee. The employee was hospitalized with multiple fractures to the back and hand.
An employee was riding a horse in the cattle pen. The horse slipped in the mud and fell on the rider. The employee suffered a fractured leg.

An employee was driving an electric pallet jack to pick an order in an aisle of the facility when the pallet jack struck the leg of a rack. The employee's left thumb became pinched between the pallet jack and the rack, resulting in a deep laceration.

On May 13, 2019, the injured employee was performing demo work with a pry bar in one hand while his other hand was leaning against a door jam. Another employee closed the door causing and pinched the injured employee's finger between the door and the door frame resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee sustained a partial amputation of a left-hand finger while operating a table saw.

On December 17, 2022, an employee was operating an electric pallet jack to move materials when his foot and leg were pinned between the pallet jack and a wall. They sustained a fracture to the lower right leg that required hospitalization.

An employee was moving a package (containing the casing for an electrical panel) from unloading to a conveyor. As the employee took the one step to the conveyor, the package fell and struck the employee's right ankle, causing a laceration.
On November 10, 2022, an employee was cutting frozen pork femur bones when their right thumb contacted the band saw blade and was amputated.
A truck driver was driving around a corner on a logging road. The trailer went over the bank, causing the cab to flip on its side. The employee suffered possible internal injuries.

An employee working inside the street barriers on the shoulder of an on-ramp was struck by a vehicle that swerved into the jobsite. The employee was hospitalized due to a fractured pelvis and internal injuries.
Two employees engaged in an altercation. One employee struck the other employee with a power drill, causing a head injury.

An employee was mowing grass on a zero turn riding lawn mower when the mower lost traction on the wet, grassy hill. The lawn mower impacted an elevated concrete structure, pinning the employee's legs between the structure and the lawn mower. They sustained a tibia fracture.
An employee was cleaning/foaming the floors between lines 2 and 3 when they slipped on a piece of chicken skin and twisted their leg. The employee was hospitalized with a fractured tibial plateau.
An employee was operating a utility loader and backed up into a horizontal beam. The employee sustained a broken rib.
At about 2:30 p.m., an employee was documenting a trailer load when a forklift was backing up and struck her, causing fractures. She was hospitalized.

A truck driver completing his delivery at a store was closing the roll down door of the truck with his right hand and closed the door on his left hand. The employee fractured the middle finger on his left hand that required surgery to repair.

An employee was installing a steel plate on an inner-bottom using an overhead crane. As the employee lifted the steel plate with the crane, it became wedged between two steel frames. He continued applying lifting force with the crane and the plate sprang loose, striking him the face. He suffered multiple facial injuries, including trauma, a broken nose, an eye socket fracture, and a skull fracture.

An employee was using a plastic rod to knock shredded polymer off the underside of a conveyor belt. The conveyor belt pulled the rod into the bottom frame. As the employee went to retrieve the rod, the belt pulled his right glove and his ring finger was lacerated and crushed between the belt and the frame. The finger was fractured and required hospitalization and surgery.

An employee was starting her shift at the fuel station. She walked past a person that had a dog carrier attached to their bicycle. The dog was on a leash, but it jumped out of the carrier and bit the employee's left arm. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.
An employee fell about 13 feet from a mezzanine to the concrete ground floor, suffering a broken ankle.
An employee was feeding a piece of material into a table saw. The sawblade amputated the employee's left index fingertip.
Two employees were injured when the scaffold they were working from was blown over by wind. The employees fell six feet and suffered fractures to their neck, arms, wrist, ribs and a concussion.
An employee was going up the starch platform when the top handrail of the platform broke and he fell 8 feet to the ground, breaking his ribs and neck bones.
An employee was checking on a client when their finger was caught in the door, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
An employee was on a ladder spraying water on a conveyor line when the employee lost balance and fell 2 feet onto the moving conveyor, suffering a broken arm.
An employee was exiting a room and caught their left pinky finger between the door and the door jamb resulting in amputation of the fingertip.

Employees were setting up to transfer tert-Butylphenol with methanol from bulk storage to 5-gallon totes. As the injured employee was disconnecting a hose, a pressure build up caused residual product to spray the employee. He sustained first-degree chemical burns to the left side of his face and body.
An employee was lifting a package and suffered a herniated disc in the lower back.

An employee was cleaning out a machine with a trainee when the air pressure line activated, turning on the machine. The employee's right hand was then caught in the machine, amputating the middle finger.
An employee was assisting others in a team lift effort to put a large bumper into the back of a truck and suffered a herniated/ruptured disk requiring surgery.
An employee was spray painting a ceiling while working from a platform on a mobile scaffold. The employee fell 9 feet from the scaffold to the floor.
An employee was caring for a patient when they were punched in the face by the patient. The employee was hospitalized.

A forklift was lowering a 7,500-pound motor onto timber cribbing. The timbers shifted and the motor moved, then slid off the forklift blades. It pinned an employee against a hydraulic skid, breaking the employee's left femur and right leg before the knee.

While a crane was lifting a jaw crusher that was being removed for repair a section of ductwork that was connected to the building fell and struck employee on the head. The employee sustained a fractured vertebra.
An employee was helping erect a batting cage when it fell and struck his head. The employee sustained a skull fracture.
An employee was exiting his pickup truck when he slipped/tripped and hit his running board(s). He sustained multiple rib fractures and was hospitalized.

An employee was removing a 2" riser pipe from a casing head with a pipe wrench when backside pressure pushed the riser up and it struck the employee's forehead. He was then covered in drilling mud, which evacuated the well behind the pipe. He suffered a forehead laceration and skull fracture.
An employee was walking in the parking lot and slipped on a puddle of water rolling his ankle resulting in a right ankle injury.

The employee was assisting with moving ground rods on a forklift when the bundle of rods shifted on the forklift and fell, breaking three fingers on the employee's right hand and amputating the middle fingertip.
On July 6, 2018, an employee was stepping off of a sprayer that was being refueled when the employee stumbled and rolled an ankle. The employee's ankle fractured and required hospitalization.
An employee was retrieving supplies and/or documents from a storage room and tripped over a step stool. She fractured her right femur.

An employee was operating a forklift to pull a load of wood pulp from a three-high stow in a warehouse. He grabbed a load from the stack with the clamp and was backing out when the load pulled an adjacent bundle, causing it to become unstable. The adjacent bundle fell against the forklift mast, causing the forklift to tip over. The employee suffered a left forearm laceration and a crushed left leg above the ankle, which required amputation.
An employee mounted a haul chain to move a piece of wood when his right leg became caught in the outfeed chain and sprocket. He was hospitalized for surgery.

Employee 1 was changing out the propane tank on his forklift while employee 2 was backing up his forklift. Due to heavy rain, there was condensation on the dock surface which caused employee 2's forklift to slide into employee 1, crushing him between the two forklifts. He sustained a pelvic fracture.

An employee was packaging meat with a plastic packing machine. The employee attempted to remove a jam in the machine when their left index finger contacted the machine's cutting blade, resulting in a 3/4-inch amputation.
An employee was shot in the abdomen and sustained an exit wound to the lower back. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was inspecting the inside of a cargo truck at a loading dock when the truck driver began to drive away, causing the employee to fall off the dock. He broke his left ankle and injured his knee.
An equalizer bushing pusher activated and caught an employee's right hand, amputating the tip of the employee's right thumb.

An employee was preparing to unload an 84-inch-thick drill bit/shaft from a flatbed truck. The part started to shift and the employee jumped out of the way and fell to the ground (3.5 feet below the edge of the trailer) and suffered a broken hip.

An employee on a horse was pushing yearlings (cattle) out of the willows to the meadow. The employee was riding his horse over to rope a yearling when the yearling turned quickly, along with the horse. The horse slipped on wet grass and fell on top of the employee. His leg was caught between the horse and the ground. The employee was hospitalized with a broken pelvis.
On June 5, 2020, an employee was using a table saw to cut wood trim when the blade caused lacerations to the middle finger, index finger, and thumb of the left hand requiring hospitalization.

On October 20, 2020, at approximately 11:45 PM, an employee was kicked in the chest while trying to restrain a combative patient. The employee developed dizziness, chest pain, and shortness of breath and was hospitalized.
An employee felt light-headed and suffered asthma exacerbation while walking down a recently waxed hallway. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was showing another employee how to perform a process on a drill press and moving shavings away from the drilled area when the employee's glove was caught in the press. The employee's left ring fingertip was amputated.
An employee tripped over the corner of a mat on the floor. She fell and broke her hip.
An employee was repairing a bucket loader in a maintenance shop. A jack kicked out, striking him in the head and knocking him to the floor. He suffered a skull fracture.
While demolishing a precipitator, an employee fell approximately 33 feet to the ground below, suffering wrist and leg fractures and tissue injuries.

On August 20, 2021, an employee was performing maintenance work on an air conditioner. The employee's steel-toed boot made contact with a 240-volt wire. The employee lost consciousness and suffered a broken right clavicle, a laceration between the right thumb and finger, and bruising to the right side of the face.

On September 15, 2023, an employee was using a table saw to cut a piece of wood when a kickback occurred, causing the employee to lose balance. They reached to catch themselves and the blade of the table saw amputated their thumb and index finger.
An employee was walking on the ground below roofing activities. A piece of wood fell off the roof and struck the employee in/near the right eye. The employee was hospitalized for surgery.

A Freehold Cartage, Inc., tank truck driver was loading flammable liquid from a storage tank. Shortly after loading began, the driver noticed the hose was jumping, indicating a interruption in product flow. After the pump was turned off the employee was told it was safe to disconnect the line, he released a clamp on the hose driver and was splashed with chemical. He suffered a second-degree chemical burn.
An employee was cutting metal with scissors. The metal cut his right hand and he was hospitalized.
An employee was stung by a bee and experienced an allergic reaction.
After installing ductwork, an employee was descending a ladder when he fell approximately 8 to 10 feet, suffering multiple fractures.

On or about January 12, 2015, an employee was injured while loosening the bolts of a rod and collar assembly on a manual assist arm. A component fell and struck his hand, amputating the tip of his left little finger.
An employee was retrieving a patient's chart when the employee tripped over an open file cabinet and fractured a shoulder.

An employee was cleaning out a cable stripper and opened the cabinet that houses the stripper wheel when his glove was caught in the wheel, pulling in his left hand. His left ring finger was amputated and his left middle finger was severely injured.
An employee was vacuuming steel grit using a 4" vacuum hose when the employee's arm up to the bicep was suctioned into the hose. The employee suffered extensive swelling and required surgery.
An employee was trying to clear jammed cardboard from a machine. His hand was caught in the machine's motor and shaft, which amputated one of his fingers.
An employee was assisting to subdue a patient when they fell and struck their head on the floor causing a subdural hematoma.
An employee fell approximately 47 feet off the grating in the air recovery area, breaking her right arm and injuring her hip.
A maintenance employee was cleaning drain pipes and fell from a 6-foot high retaining wall to the concrete surface below and sustained fractures to both ankles.
An employee was cleaning out a concrete mixer when it started up with him inside. His foot was amputated.
An employee fell approximately 12 feet while disassembling bleacher risers.
An employee was delivering mail into a door slot when a dog bit his right hand, amputating the right index finger at the first knuckle.
On 12/08/2020, at 12:30 p.m., an employee was using a knockout machine when his right index finger slipped between the machine's hammer and its casting, resulting in a fingertip amputation.

The injured employee was spotting for a dump truck while it backed up to dump crushed stone near an approximately 76-inch deep excavation. While signaling the dump truck, the injured employee lost his footing and fell into the open hole, landing upright, and sustaining a fractured right ankle.

A temporary worker amputated four fingers while removing an energized fan situated on top of a dust receptacle bag that collected dust from an attached industrial shredder. The fan was not locked out at the time.

An employee was welding in a submarine s sail area. The lookout area of the sail has two large hatch doors with mechanisms on both sides that can latch and lock onto the top when closed. The hatch doors are also usually spring-loaded to prevent them from falling abruptly. Neither door has the latches installed, and the starboard door s spring was not installed to the foundation. The starboard door was raised to the closed position, with the employee working underneath. At approximately 9:20 AM, the employee completed his weld and called his supervisor over for inspection. When his supervisor began to step down into the work area from the port side, the starboard hatch door fell, striking the employee in the head and face and pinning his head between the ship s foundation and the door itself. He suffered blunt force trauma to his head and face, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was using a chainsaw to cut a felled tree into sections once it was on the ground. The tree broke/snapped, and a section of the tree struck and pinned the employee's lower leg, causing multiple tibia and fibula fractures.
An employee sustained a broken foot after it was ran over by a forklift resulting in hospitalization.
An employee was working the strip line and reported the smell of fumes suspected to be hydrogen chloride (HCl). The employee was hospitalized for headache, nausea and a sore throat.
An employee was operating a table saw. The sawblade caused an amputation to the employee's right index finger.
An employee was using a circular saw to cut 2x4 stakes for concrete work when they sustained lacerations to the right leg. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was helping a forklift operator load a 1000 lbs. marble slab when the slab slipped out of the clamp and fell onto his left big toe amputating it.

An employee was in a scissor lift applying plastic sheeting to redecorate the walls of a shop when the employee fell 6 feet from the lift to the cement floor, suffering a head injury that required hospitalization.
An employee was operating a slitting machine when his left hand was contacted by either the coil or the mandrel. His left index fingertip was amputated.

An employee was injured on September 17, 2015, while retrieving a mold for setup of a plastic injection molding machine. The employee was retrieving a mold from a rack system approximately 8 feet tall. He climbed to the second shelf of the rack system (approximately 4-5 feet) off the floor. When attempting to descend the rack system he slipped and fell to the floor below. He landed on his buttocks and back.
An employee tripped over a paver and fell to the ground resulting in a fractured right knee.
An employee was teaching swimming lessons when a participant jumped into the pool and landed on the employee. The employee sustained injuries to his head, neck and shoulders and was hospitalized.

At about 11:30 a.m. on May 28, 2020, an employee was clearing a clog from the classification system for a plastic media recovery system. When the clog cleared, the open adjustable rotor started to spin, causing amputations to the employee's left index, middle, and ring fingers (with bone loss to the furthest knuckle on the middle finger).
An employee was walking in a main aisle when a forklift ran over the employee's right foot. The employee was hospitalized and had surgery.

While driving to her work site in an apartment complex, an employee was caught in a crossfire of gunshots being fired between unknown third parties in the parking lot. The employee sustained gunshot wounds to the chin, forearm and buttocks.
An employee was climbing a ladder while carrying a garage door track when he fell 6 feet to the floor below, resulting in broken bones in his back.
An employee was removing fat/meat that was clogging a drain in a separating room. An auger amputated his right index finger.
An employee was running the table saw and lacerated fingers on his left hand.

Employees were placing a 50-foot wood pole into the ground to support electrical lines. The line truck could not fit between the alleyway where the pole was to be placed. The injured employee was tasked with securing a bonding wire to the pole. He straddled the pole to about 12 feet to begin securing the grounding wire. As he stapled the wire, he lost his balance and fell onto the hard pavement/dirt surface. He was hospitalized and required surgery to repair his lower back.

An employee was on the bumper of a van that was taking materials back to the stationary area. The employee fell off, striking his head on the pavement. The employee suffered brain hemorrhaging that required surgery.
An employee was working with the reclaimer. The valve released pressure crushing the employee's hand and amputating three fingers.
An employee was operating a shear press. The shear amputated the employee's left index finger.

An employee was changing the bit of a magnetic drill when the machine activated. The chuck key punctured the employee's left hand under the knuckle of the middle finger. The employee was hospitalized.

An employee was changing out a liquor gun for a recovery boiler when black liquor (caustic-type material) contacted the employee's face. He was hospitalized with second degree burns to the face and upper chest.

On April 15, 2021, an employee was removing rust from the spindle of a lathe using an emery cloth when their glove become entangled in the back chuck, resulting in a partial degloving of the right middle finger and complete amputation of the right ring and pinky fingers.

An employee climbed up onto stacked storage containers to check for parts. During his descent, he jumped from a height of approximately 5 feet. Upon landing, his right knee buckled and he fell to the ground, resulting in a right hip fracture that required surgery.
An employee was cutting beef and lacerating his left arm requiring stiches and surgery.
An employee was clearing a jam from the blow molding machine and amputated the right index fingertip.

An employee was riding a horse while herding/checking cattle when the gate to the pen contacted the horse she was riding. The horse was startled and the rider was bucked off resulting in a fractured right clavicle, right scapula and ribs on the right side.
An employee developed a hernia while lifting a hand cart into a trailer. He was hospitalized.
An employee was picking up a box from a pallet when they experienced back pain due to a possible herniated disc. The employee was hospitalized.
An employee was adjusting the cutting height of a 21-inch push mower when the blade lacerated and amputated two of the employee's fingers.
An employee was using a deli slicer when its blade cut the tip of his right thumb, causing a partial amputation.

A utility line construction crew was in the process of replacing a wooden utility pole with a new metal utility pole and metal cross arm. After the new metal pole and cross arm was installed the crew wrapped an insulated blanket around the pole above the cross arm. Insulators were installed on the cross arm. A crew member was in a lift bucket and was using metal quick ties to connect the power lines to the cross arm insulators. The crew member tied one of the quick ties to an insulator and was preparing to tie one of the power lines to the insulator. The free end of the quick tie slipped out of the crew member's hand and curled underneath the insulated blanket contacting the power line. The power line arced and burned the crew member's face.

An employee was using a forklift to load empty pallets onto a trailer. His forklift struck another lift, parked nearby. He suffered a laceration to the right lower leg that required hospitalization and stitches.

An employee was weatherproofing a construction area by placing plastic in the area. He was tucking weatherproofing around an open door when a coworker closed the door on his right index finger, amputating the fingertip and fracturing the finger.
An employee sustained a knee injury while pulling a pallet off a truck.

On October 14, 2016, an employee had her finger in a pivot point on a backhoe assembly to determine if the two holes were aligned. The employee operated a hydraulic control that moved the pivot point and amputated her right index finger. The pivot point on the backhoe assembly was not guarded at the time of the incident.
An employee mis-stepped while getting off a tour bus. The impact onto the ground surface caused a compound fracture to their leg requiring hospitalization.

Two employees were cleaning a 30-foot tube with a chemical mixture of hydrochloric and nitric acids inside. The tubing became over-pressurized and the end cap dislodged, spraying the mixture onto the employees. They were both hospitalized with chemical burns.
An employee was clearing a clog in fiber processing equipment when his hand came in contact with a moving part, injuring his fingers and resulting in an amputation.
On September 19, 2015, an employee was riding a clothing cart down a hill. The cart tipped over and ejected the employee. The employee was hospitalized with a head injury.
An employee tripped when she went to step on the curb in the parking lot while on lunch break. The employee fell on the ground and sustained a fractured right hip.
An employee was exposed to and came into contact with approximately 46,000 volts of electrical current from a downed power line, resulting in third degree electrical burns.
An employee was operating a band saw to cut slabs of cooked bacon when the saw cut his finger, resulting in an amputation to his right index fingertip.

An employee was installing light posts when the derrick truck swung the light post and contacted the power line behind them. The trailer holding the post became energized, and the employee received severe electrical burns.

A RackMasters employee and a temporary employee were in a scissor lift at an elevation of approximately 20 feet, using a hand-held tool to unscrew angle joints and dismantle a rack. They were removing the final piece of the rack, which was against the wall of the facility (almost flush with the wall), when the rack became loose, fell, and hit the scissor lift. The scissor lift then fell over and the two employees jumped when it was about 2 feet from the ground. The employees suffered a spinal fracture and fractured arm.
An employee was moving a cart with tomatoes when two carts bumped each other, resulting in amputation of the employee's thumb tip.
An employee fell off of a moving garbage truck, hitting the ground and sustaining a head injury.
An employee was tack-welding a small part onto a larger assembly when a weld wire bounced and punctured his left index finger, requiring hospitalization.

An employee entered a delivery truck to check the product in it. The truck drove off with the employee in it. When it slowed down, the employee jumped out of the semi-truck and fell onto the road, suffering a broken skull. He was hospitalized.
An employee fell out of a golf cart-type vehicle. The employee's head struck the ground, requiring hospitalization.

An employee was sitting in the cab of an excavator as employees were taking a trench box apart. A pin was pulled and the trench box's connecting bar went into the cab of the excavator, striking the employee's left leg and fracturing it below the knee. The employee was hospitalized and required surgery.

An employee was dumping a self-tilting trash hopper into a compactor from a forklift. The employee reached up with his right hand to grab the mechanical lever to dump the hopper. The hopper dumped and then bounced back, striking the employee's left index finger, resulting in a partial amputation.

On January 2, 2019, at 11:30 a.m., an employee was transferring anhydrous ammonia from bullet tanks to two 1,000-gallon nurse wagons when the cross-over line connecting the nurse wagons ruptured, exposing the employee to anhydrous ammonia. He suffered chemical burns to the right side of his face and his respiratory system, requiring hospitalization.
On February 22, 2017, at approximately 4:00 PM, an employee was operating a circular saw to cut a small block of a 2x4 when the saw amputated his left thumb.

An employee was helping a customer cut an electrical cable. After the cable was cut, the customer pulled the cable and it was dragged behind the feet of the injured employee, causing her to trip and fall. She hit her head on the ground.

An employee was standing on a pallet while retrieving apparel boxes. As she turned around to dismount the pallet, her foot was caught on a piece of plastic and she fell to the floor. She landed on and broke her left shoulder.
An employee was leading a horse when it kicked her, breaking her ribs.

A janitor was entering a restroom, holding a mop with her left hand and the door with her right hand. The door slammed shut, catching her right middle finger between the door and the door jamb. The fingertip was amputated without bone loss.
An employee was injured in a fight and suffered bleeding in the brain.
An employee slipped on snow-covered ice, suffering an injury to his left foot/ankle.

An employee had been working on a vehicle. He was unlocking the mechanism of the vehicle lift when the lift engaged; the hammer came down and struck the end of his right middle finger. The fingertip was amputated at the base of the nail.
An employee was walking into the store when they slipped on an icy sidewalk, resulting in a sprain/tear in the left knee.
An employee was installing insulating boots on a de-energized 5-kilovolt termination and suffered an electrical shock.
An employee was climbing down a roof access hatch ladder. About halfway down, he fell, landing on the ground about 8 feet below. He suffered a broken left femur and was hospitalized.
An employee was troubleshooting a fly knife on an extruder machine when their right thumb was caught by the fly knife, resulting in a partial amputation.

An employee was standing next to his log truck while the customer was unloading it. Another truck drove by and turned a corner. A log hanging off the back of that truck swung around and struck the employee's legs, resulting in fractures.

Employee missed a stair rise while descending a flight of stairs, but did not fall. After a few hours, the employee complained of pain and was brought to the emergency room. The doctor's diagnosis was a fractured hip. Employee was admitted to hospital for pending surgery.

Two employees in a bucket truck were working at the top of a distribution pole. A mechanical jumper came in contact with a power line while they were moving lines. An arc flash occurred and one employee was hospitalized for electric shock and second degree burns to the back and abdomen.
An employee was informed of a suspected shoplifter in the store and went to confront the suspect. A physical altercation began and the employee sustained a fracture to his right lower leg.

The injured employee was training a new employee to use an edger. The hydraulic arm, that is used to keep core material in place, came down and crushed the injured employee's right foot. The employee required an amputation and was hospitalized.
An employee arrived at work and was walking into the store through the parking lot. The employee tripped over a curb and fell to the ground, sustaining a femur fracture.
A fork truck operator lost his balance while dismounting from the vehicle, fell and broke his hip.
An employee suffered a broken right knee while stepping off a pickup truck.
An employee tripped over a telephone cord and fell.
On August 21, 2023, an employee was reaching for product on the shelf in the cooler when their back gave out. The employee was hospitalized for an exacerbation of bulging disks.
An employee was injured while hooking up two pieces of steel when the pig tail hook became caught on a beam on the ground, which rolled the beam onto the employee's leg.
